scope: Six-lead research follow-up; statuses are distinct from scientific completion.

actions.next_action: Track acknowledgment; acquire original attachments/readout and applicable error rules, then compare authenticated paired output.
actions.acceptance: Source/custody/layout/output and clock joins are established; documented error treatment explains inclusion/exclusion of affected samples.
actions.could_change_assessment: Ordinary write/readout behavior may explain discrepancies; an authenticated conflicting original could strengthen a specific discrepancy.

actions.next_action: Track acknowledgment; obtain missing appendices and receipt/decision/order/allocation linkage.
actions.acceptance: Actual issue/version, independent receipt clock and matched transaction subset permit the predefined comparison.
actions.could_change_assessment: Matching post-receipt orders strengthen the ordinary-information explanation; mismatches do not uniquely establish foreknowledge.

actions.next_action: Identify holder and retrieve native spectra/phase data and specimen/run crosswalk before a matched-region test.
actions.acceptance: Authenticated identical-region measurements, calibration, controls and uncertainty discriminate the material hypotheses.
actions.could_change_assessment: Ordinary coating, energetic component, mixed populations or unresolved measurement remain possible outcomes.

actions.next_action: Track existing request; seek correction, actual recipient delivery and administrative action/non-action/closure records.
actions.acceptance: Original/corrected versions join to dated receipt and disposition evidence.
actions.could_change_assessment: A substantive correction and implemented disposition can resolve parts of the accountability gap; summaries alone cannot.
actions.verified_activity_scope: Operational-record source research; does not establish production or continuous request monitoring.

actions.next_action: Recover traceable continuous originals and frame/clock/edit/receiver joins; quantify relevant geometry uncertainty.
actions.acceptance: Original source/time/feature correspondence supports an independently testable physical comparison.
actions.could_change_assessment: Editing, speech, handling or ordinary collapse sources could explain a feature; an authenticated mechanism-specific signature could strengthen a specified alternative.

actions.next_action: Map item/member/version/custodian/request category/delivery or withholding, then authenticate effective run state and outputs.
actions.acceptance: A matched historical package and legitimate compatible runtime permit an unchanged replay against designated outputs.
actions.could_change_assessment: Authentic supplied replacements may resolve dependencies; authenticated conflicts may strengthen a bounded reproducibility concern without identifying collapse cause.
actions.verified_activity_scope: Broader technical investigation active; exact next-action ownership not verified.

owner_note: A true activity flag identifies observed research activity, not a new assignment or a guarantee of continuing execution.
